Drives the full in-suite guest experience by ensuring Waxers deliver consistent, high-quality services aligned with brand standards and protocols. Promotes continuous improvement by sharing best practices and success drivers across all centers. Drives retention and talent growth by ensuring every manager meets the expectations of a top-tier corporate center through consistent coaching, feedback, and performance management. Leads recruitment and talent selection strategy to attract and retain the best candidates (all roles), setting a standard for hiring excellence and bench strength to support business growth and succession planning. Ensures all recruiting, hiring, and onboarding practices meet compliance and deliver a seamless associate experience. Builds leadership capability through structured coaching, feedback, and development plans aligned to business priorities and results. Leads and administers performance management and disciplinary action decisively, reinforcing accountability, fairness, and continuous development. Champions EWC’s vision, values, and culture to drive engagement, teamwork, and results-focused collaboration. Drives accountability check-ins and goal setting, ensuring every associate is aligned with business objectives and performance standards. Empowers managers and teams to build and grow their business through local marketing initiatives including business relationships, driving personal referrals, etc., to increase ticket count and remain consistent with all efforts to increase new and existing guest retention. Conducts regular center visits, performance reviews, and monthly manager meetings to ensure progress, alignment, and consistent execution. Operations Excellence Maintains a consistent field presence by spending approximately 4 days each week in centers to coach, observe, and drive execution, with one administrative day generally reserved for business reviews, planning, and follow-up. Ensures all locations operate in full compliance with EWC policies, procedures, and brand standards to maintain consistency and operational discipline. Drives a growth mindset, focusing decision making on people and P&L impact. Upholds all operational requirements outlined in the Center Operations User Guide. Maximizes scheduling and productivity through proactive labor management and demand forecasting, ensuring capacity is aligned to sales goals. Enforces loss prevention, safety, and compliance standards to protect people, assets, and reputation. Ensures timely completion of all operational deliverables and reports with accuracy and accountability. Visual & Brand Standards Holds Center Managers accountable for flawless execution of brand visuals and marketing guidelines. Ensures centers maintain impeccable cleanliness, organization, and presentation – representing EWC’s brand promise at all times. Conducts regular audits to verify compliance with brand and visual standards, ensuring each location reflects the quality and professionalism expected of a corporate center. Reinforces accountability for maintaining all service, retail, and back-of-house areas to EWC standards of excellence What Sets You Apart Ability to work a flexible schedule to meet business needs. Proven ability to motivate and develop high-performing teams by balancing accountability with support, driving business outcomes while cultivating manager growth and ownership. Minimum of 2 years’ experience managing multi- unit in service or specialty retail environment.
